result.title: Amortized Nonlinear Variable Selection with Prior-Data Fitted Networks
result.summary: Variable selection is an important task for interpreting potentially complex systems in fields such as biology, business, and sociology. The importance of variable selection has attracted considerable attention in statistics and machine learning. In this paper, we are mainly interested in model-agnostic variable selection for identifying variables that have general nonlinear dependence on the response. We propose MambaPFN, short for Model-Agnostic Markov BlAnket selection with Prior-data Fitted Networks, which is built upon the Transformer, a building block of many popular large language models. Specifically, we consider a functional-mapping perspective on variable-selection learning, in which the Transformer is treated as a learnable mapping from a dataset to its relevant variables. To learn this mapping, MambaPFN introduces three new components: (i) a faithful, rich, and scalable scheme for generating pretraining data, (ii) an objective that targets each variable's posterior inclusion probability, and (iii) a modified Transformer architecture tailored to variable selection. Once pretrained, MambaPFN is applied to new datasets without parameter updates. Empirically, MambaPFN achieves desirable variable-selection performance in simulation studies and exhibits a scaling law---more pretraining datasets and larger models can continuously improve its performance. Applied to a Facebook comments dataset, MambaPFN selects the fewest variables and achieves the highest computational efficiency and predictive performance, improving upon the best baselines by about 20%.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MambaPFN，用 prior-data fitted network 把 Transformer 训练成从数据集到各变量后验纳入概率的摊销映射，并配套大规模预训练数据生成方案与改进架构，实现免参数更新的模型无关非线性变量选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单次前向即输出每个输入变量的后验纳入概率」的摊销推断，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献分配的训练监督形式存在可核查的类比，但原文为表格数据、不涉及多模态推理。
